units.note: Final reply to the Achaeans (oud' an ho Lakedaimonion ... aphistetai demos, ou deesei tous Achaious thaumazein ean me pros autous hegontai) is syntactically doubtful: the subject and sense of hegontai pros autous are unclear (possibly corrupt), and the current English silently resolves it as 'not conducting their leadership in a way acceptable to Rome'. Rest of chapter checked and accurate.

findings.quote: also took action against their sons
findings.problem: epaneilen (epanaireo) means 'killed in addition'; Greek says Philip killed the sons as well, not merely 'took action against' them.

units.note: Lacuna correctly marked [...]. Xanthos dative (enagizousin toi Xanthoi) is obscure fragment; left as is.

findings.quote: for so long because, obeying the ephors as though they were parents, they endured
findings.problem: tosouton chronon ... hoson (correlative): they preserved the hegemony for just as long as they obeyed the ephors and endured joint kingship; English turns the temporal correlative into a causal 'because'.
findings.proposed_fix: for just as long as, obeying the ephors as though they were parents, they endured

units.note: Numbers 3,000 and 15,000 talents (trischilion; myrion kai pentakischilion) correct; Publius = Africanus, brother Lucius.

findings.quote: carry their anger against their own people so far
findings.problem: homophylous means those of the same race/kindred (i.e. fellow Greeks), not 'their own people'; as written the English contradicts the immediate object 'their enemies'.
findings.proposed_fix: carry their anger against men of their own race so far

findings.quote: by the war. * The Messenians had long
findings.problem: Greek has a gap (* / ** before palai men hoi Messenioi) and the sentence resumes mid-thought; English marks it only with a bare asterisk and reads on as if whole, unlike the [...] used for the other lacunae in the chapter.
findings.proposed_fix: by the war. [...] The Messenians had long

units.note: Other two lacunae (after periechesthai; after exagein ek tou zen) are marked [...] correctly.
